caveats:
Currently the ADM2_TH (Thai language) name for administrative level 2 feature "Pom Prap Sattru Phai" [TH1008] is incorrect.  The correct name is  ป้อมปราบศัตรูพ่าย.

Earlier problems with the live service rendering Thai labels are thought to be have been corrected.  Users experiencing any difficulties should contact the contributor.


UPDATE (2019 03 01)
Shapefiles have been replaced.  The previous versions were derived from the geodatabase and had truncated field names.  There is no change to the content.

name: cod-ab-tha
notes:
Thailand administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 77 Province  
- Admin 2: 928 District  
- Admin 3: 7425 Sub-district (Tambon)  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 22 January 2022: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 01 January 2022: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 January 2022: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-roap).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
